parameters_not_exposed.name: filter_prediction
parameters_not_exposed.reason: Upstream defect in this environment. celltypist.dotplot(..., filter_prediction>0) raises KeyError on an in-memory upstream AnnotationResult, with no CSV round-trip involved. The filtered dot_size_df keeps a CategoricalIndex with all categories (plot.py:157-158, :174), and scanpy 1.12.4 DotPlot then reorders by the unused categories (_dotplot.py:325-331). Evidence: tmp/impl_celltypist_tutorial_ml/scripts/probe_filter_prediction_upstream.py, log tmp/impl_celltypist_tutorial_ml/logs/probe_filter_prediction_upstream.log (0.0 works; 0.2 gives KeyError for both return_fig=True and False). Attempt 1 exposed it and failed the smoke; attempt 2 removed it. It was not used in either tutorial. Not worked around.

parameters_not_exposed.name: prediction_order / reference_order / title / swap_axes / cmap etc.
parameters_not_exposed.reason: Not used in the tutorials and no clear user need; upstream defaults are kept.

io_adaptations: AnnotationResult reconstruction (_load_annotation_result). predicted_labels.csv is read with index_col=0, dtype=str and keep_default_na=False, so cell IDs, Leiden IDs and labels stay literal strings. predicted_labels and majority_voting are converted with astype('category'). This reproduces upstream's sorted categories (classifier.py:389 dtype='category'; :498 astype('category')), which dotplot uses for row order (plot.py:48). over_clustering is left as str because it is not used. decision_matrix.csv and probability_matrix.csv are read with index_col=0 and converters={0: str}, so numeric-looking cell IDs are not coerced. Their column headers (model cell types, including names with '/') are preserved.
annotated.h5ad is opened with anndata.read_h5ad(..., backed='r'), so X stays on disk; only obs is used. The file handle is closed in a finally block.

Alignment checks. Cell IDs in predicted_labels.csv must be unique, and must be identical in order and value to the decision_matrix.csv index, the probability_matrix.csv index and the annotated.h5ad obs_names. decision and probability columns must be equal. Otherwise the tool raises ValueError, naming the first mismatching row. This is needed because _get_fraction_prob_df mixes label-indexed Series with a positional score list (plot.py:40-42).

Probabilities for the boxplots come from probability_matrix.csv, not from to_adata(insert_prob=True) obs columns (h5ad '/'-name issue). The columns are model.cell_types in model order, so the selection is equivalent to ml cell 82.

The crosstab uses obs[reference_key] from annotated.h5ad and predicted_labels.csv[use_as_prediction]. These are the same values that to_adata inserts into obs (classifier.py:114), so it equals ml cell 47's adata.obs crosstab.
Input errors are raised before any output directory is created: missing dir/files, missing reference_key, missing majority_voting column, absent reference groups, misaligned cell IDs.
stdout is redirected to stderr for the duration of the call (celltypist's logger already uses stderr). Figures use the Agg backend and are closed after saving.
